title: Monster
description: Schema for a game monster or NPC, reflecting the backend Go 'Monster' struct.

user_id.description: The ID of the user who owns this monster. Will be set by the backend, not the LLM.

type.description: The creature type of the monster (e.g., 'Humanoid', 'Beast', 'Dragon', 'Aberration', 'Undead').

alignment.description: The alignment of the monster (e.g., 'Lawful Evil', 'Chaotic Good', 'Unaligned').

challenge_rating.description: The challenge rating of the monster as a string (e.g., '1/2', '1', '5', 'CR 10').

proficiency_bonus.description: The proficiency bonus of the monster. Backend will calculate if not provided or if CR changes.

armor_class.description: The Armor Class (AC) of the monster.

hit_points.description: The average Hit Points (HP) of the monster.

hit_dice.description: The hit dice expression for the monster's HP (e.g., '5d8 + 10').

speed.description: The movement speed of the monster (e.g., '30 ft, fly 60 ft, swim 30 ft').

skills.description: List of skill proficiencies with their bonus (e.g., 'Perception +5', 'Stealth +7').

damage_immunities.description: List of damage types the monster is immune to (e.g., 'fire', 'bludgeoning').

damage_resistances.description: List of damage types the monster resists (e.g., 'cold', 'piercing from nonmagical attacks').

condition_immunities.description: List of conditions the monster is immune to (e.g., 'charmed', 'frightened').

senses.description: Senses of the monster (e.g., 'darkvision 60 ft, passive Perception 12').

languages.description: Languages the monster can speak or understand (e.g., 'Common, Draconic').

notes.description: User's original text description or general notes about the monster.

image_url.description: URL to the monster's image in S3. Will be set by the backend after image generation.

attacks.description: List of attack actions the monster can make.

actions.description: List of non-attack actions the monster can take (e.g., 'Frightful Presence').

special_traits.description: List of passive or special abilities (e.g., 'Magic Resistance', 'Keen Hearing and Sight').

legendary_actions.description: List of legendary actions (for legendary creatures).

reactions.description: List of reactions the monster can take.

lair_actions.description: List of lair actions (for creatures with lairs).

environments.description: List of environments where the monster typically lives (e.g., 'Forest', 'Desert', 'Underdark').

source.description: The source of the monster data (e.g., 'User Generated', 'Monster Manual').

visual_description.description: An optimized text description for an image generation AI (e.g., 'A fearsome red dragon with scales like molten gold, sharp claws, and smoke curling from its nostrils.').

description.description: Full description of the attack (e.g., 'Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6 + 3 piercing damage.').

is_legendary.description: True if this is a legendary action attack.

weapon_id.description: Optional: ID of a specific weapon associated with this attack.

description.description: Full description of the action (e.g., 'The dragon makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.').

is_legendary.description: True if this is a legendary action.
